title: Mediterranean Blue Paper Towel Holder, 14-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Countertop Stand, Contemporary Style, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Mediterranean Blue, paper towel holder with 14-inch height and 5 x 5-inch footprint, solid brass construction for countertop kitchen use, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Freestanding paper towel stand / valet keeps rolls accessible without wall mounting. Weighted base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps protect countertop surfaces. Contemporary, modern design for crisp, clean kitchens and minimalist spaces. Corrosion-free, rust-free performance with a designer finish and multiple lifetime designer finish options. Includes paper towel holder. No assembly required. Product size: 5 in L x 14 in H x 5 in W; product weight 4.8 lb. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
